result.summary: The page renders mostly correctly with consistent layout, but there are a few styling/legibility issues: the promotional banner heading is rendered with very low contrast (fainter than its own subtext), and card controls/icons are styled inconsistently across sections.

issues.description: In the '3 free deliveries for you' banner, the heading text is rendered in a very light, washed-out color that is actually fainter and harder to read than the smaller subtext ('Use code TALLINN3 at checkout • min. order €10') beneath it, producing insufficient contrast against the pale green background.
issues.suggestion: Render the banner heading in a stronger color/opacity (e.g., dark green or near-black) so it is at least as legible as the body text and meets WCAG contrast requirements.

issues.description: The favorite/heart button is styled inconsistently between cards: the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows a bare outline heart on the image, while the pizza card shows the same heart inside a dark circular background.
issues.suggestion: Use one consistent treatment (e.g., always the heart inside a semi-transparent circular background) for the favorite button on all restaurant cards.

issues.description: On the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card the delivery information is duplicated: an '€0 delivery' pill badge appears on the image and '€0 delivery' is repeated again in the metadata line ('25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen').
issues.suggestion: Show the delivery fee once (preferably in the metadata line) and use the image badge for a different, non-redundant highlight such as a discount or promo.
